finding: Retained source bindings previously validated repository-relative paths and blob SHA shape but did not require each lookup to declare the exact target commit, approved immutable lookup method, and UTC verification time.

requirements_added: Every source binding must carry a 40-character target_commit equal to the pipeline receipt target commit.
Every source binding must use github-contents-at-commit or git-ls-tree-at-commit.
Every source binding must carry a parseable ISO-8601 UTC verified_at timestamp.
Unverified extra fields remain stripped from the composite receipt.

verification.method: node --test operations/tools/vercel-retained-evidence-chain-receipt.test.mjs using the committed-equivalent source and test contents
covered_failures: missing, non-UTC, or invalid verification timestamp

deployment.reason: CURRENT_STATE requires operations-only work while Vercel build capacity is exhausted.

rollback.route: Revert commits e850e0d234ea97313cc4ab810028078836104ffa and cdf909bf6c65f1386cea4f954a6df7be9b919086 in reverse order.

limits: The validator checks proof metadata consistency; it does not itself query GitHub to establish that the declared blob exists at the target commit.
No Vercel deployment, browser run, physical-device audio test, or immutable deployment identity was produced in this slice.
falsification_route: Supply a source binding from a different commit, an unapproved mutable lookup method, or a non-UTC timestamp; receipt construction must fail closed. Separately compare each declared blob SHA with an authenticated GitHub contents or git ls-tree lookup at the exact target commit.
